# L2Cache — Full Documentation & Product Specification

> Comprehensive product context, architecture documentation, developer tools catalog, and engineering details for L2Cache (macOS).

---

## 1. Executive Summary

L2Cache is a native macOS application designed for software engineers, data scientists, DevOps specialists, and power users who require reliable clipboard history, command-line snippet tracking, on-device AI intelligence, and developer utilities with absolute privacy guarantees.

- **Primary Website**: https://l2cache.amvo.store/en
- **Mac App Store**: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/l2cache-clipboard-manager/id6740089851
- **License Model**: $4.99 USD one-time purchase, lifetime license, no recurring subscriptions, Family Sharing enabled.
- **Operating System Requirements**: macOS 14.0 (Sonoma), macOS 15.0+ (Sequoia). Universal binary for Apple Silicon (M1/M2/M3/M4/Pro/Max/Ultra) and Intel x86_64.

---

## 2. Core Architecture & Privacy Invariants

### 2.1 100% Local, Zero Cloud Sync
- All clipboard history, images, files, and metadata are stored in a local SQLite database on the user's Mac.
- L2Cache does not maintain any external backend servers, cloud sync APIs, user accounts, or telemetry services.
- Outbound network requests: 0 (verified by network inspection and App Store privacy manifest).

### 2.2 SQLite FTS5 Search Engine
- Uses SQLite with the Full-Text Search (FTS5) extension and Write-Ahead Logging (WAL) mode.
- Capable of indexing over 100,000 clipboard entries while maintaining sub-millisecond query latency.
- Dedicated background worker threads handle SQLite writes and indexing, preventing any UI blocking on the main AppKit/SwiftUI runloop.

### 2.3 Password Manager & Sensitive Data Protection
- Automatically ignores transient clipboard copies flagged with `org.nspasteboard.TransientType`, `org.nspasteboard.ConcealedType`, or `org.nspasteboard.AutoGeneratedType`.
- Built-in exclusions for 1Password, Bitwarden, Apple Keychain, KeePassXC, LastPass, and Dashlane.
- Regex rules detect and mask sensitive tokens, API keys, and JWT signatures.

### 2.4 Resource Efficiency
- Idle memory footprint: <15 MB RAM.
- Idle CPU consumption: 0.0%.
- Instant wakeup on hotkey trigger without background battery drain.

---

## 3. Product Features & Capabilities

### 3.1 Multi-Format Clipboard History
- Retains plain text, formatted rich text (RTF/HTML), code snippets with auto-language detection, images (PNG, JPEG, TIFF, WebP), files, and hex/RGB color swatches.
- Quick preview via QuickLook (`Spacebar`).
- Pinning and tagging for frequently reused snippets and templates.

### 3.2 Developer Intelligence & Terminal History
- **Mac Command History**: Captures commands run across bash, zsh, fish, and terminal sessions with syntax highlighting and instant fuzzy filtering.
- **AI Coding Session Tracking**: Logs and analyzes prompts, token counts, and completion context from coding assistants (Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, Aider, Cursor).
- **Apple Intelligence Integration**: Leverages macOS on-device Foundation Models for local text summarization, proofreading, and code conversion without sending prompt data to third-party cloud APIs.

### 3.3 Custom Actions & Pipeline Automation
- Define custom transformations using regular expressions, shell scripts, or built-in macro functions.
- Examples: Strip ANSI escape codes, slugify strings, convert snake_case to camelCase, escape SQL strings, format Markdown tables, decode base64 payloads.

### 3.4 Built-in Offline Developer Utilities
L2Cache includes integrated offline tools that can be triggered directly from the clipboard overlay:
1. **JSON Formatter & Validator**: Format messy JSON, validate syntax with line/column error reporting, minify, and explore JSON trees.
2. **JWT Decoder**: Decode header and payload claims of JSON Web Tokens, inspect expiration timestamps (`exp`, `nbf`, `iat`), and inspect structure without leaking sensitive tokens to third-party web decoders.
3. **Screenshot OCR**: On-device Apple Vision OCR to extract text, code snippets, or error messages from screenshots and images.
4. **Regex Clipboard Tester**: Live interactive regular expression matcher with capture group breakdown.
5. **SQL Test Data Generator**: Create synthetic dataset rows and generate PostgreSQL, MySQL, and SQLite `INSERT` statements.

## 5. Comparison Matrix

| Feature | L2Cache | Maccy | Paste | Raycast | Alfred |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| **Price** | $4.99 One-time | Free / Open Source | $14.99/year Sub | Freemium / $8/mo | $34+ Powerpack |
| **Developer Intelligence** | Yes (Built-in) | No | No | Via extensions | Via workflows |
| **Terminal History** | Yes (Dedicated) | No | No | No | Via file search |
| **On-Device Vision OCR** | Yes | No | Yes | Via extension | No |
| **Developer Tools (JSON/JWT/SQL)** | Yes (Built-in) | No | No | Extension based | Workflow based |
| **Privacy / Zero Cloud** | 100% Local | 100% Local | Uses iCloud Sync | Cloud hybrid | 100% Local |
| **Idle Memory (RAM)** | <15 MB | ~30 MB | ~100 MB | ~150-250 MB | ~40 MB |
| **Native Architecture** | Swift / SQLite FTS5 | Swift / CoreData | Swift | React / Node engine | Objective-C / Swift |
